sentences.en: I don't call it colonization, I call it systematic raw materials exploitation.
sentences.zh: 我不叫它殖民，我称之为系统的原材料开采。

sentences.en: We'll begin a systematic search of the town.
sentences.zh: 我们将开始对整个城镇进行系统性的搜查。

sentences.en: Logic is a systematic method of coming to the wrong conclusion with confidence.
sentences.zh: 逻辑是一种自信地得出错误结论的系统方法。

senses.zh: 系统的；体系的；有系统的
